chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abi Jamilah, from Abi Usamah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: that he was asked about al-witr, and he said:
It is a sunnah (prophetic practice), not an obligation.

key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the witr prayer being asked about in the narration
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a prescribed prophetic practice that is recommended

ai.seo_question: Is the witr prayer obligatory or recommended in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the witr prayer is sunnah (prophetic practice) and not fard (obligatory). It clarifies the legal status of al-witr within the framework of Shia fiqh concerning recommended and obligatory prayers.
